en.html: I ground my back teeth together. Hard. Hard. Hard. My arms were about to take a life. I did not stop them. Because even so, I had a reason to fight. The reason was my justice. Mine alone. Carry my own justice through, declare the enemy evil, kill him. Somewhere, somebody would hate me. To that person, the enemy I had killed was justice. Therefore I was evil. Do justice. Become evil. Both at once. Because the one I killed was evil and justice both. Good◆ and Evil◆ Balance◆ Each Other. ............Yes. This was what killing a person meant. I put that truth in the center of my heart. Looked straight at it. And killed one human being.
en.text:
I ground my back teeth together.

Hard. Hard. Hard.

My arms were about to take a life. I did not stop them.

Because even so, I had a reason to fight.

The reason was my justice. Mine alone. Carry my own justice through, declare the enemy evil, kill him.

Somewhere, somebody would hate me. To that person, the enemy I had killed was justice. Therefore I was evil.

Do justice. Become evil. Both at once.

Because the one I killed was evil and justice both.

Good◆ and Evil◆

Balance◆ Each Other.

............Yes.

This was what killing a person meant.

I put that truth in the center of my heart.

Looked straight at it.

And killed one human being.

ja.html: 奥歯を噛む。 　強く。強く。強く。 　いま人命を奪おうとする両腕を、決して止めずに。 　何故なら。 　――それでも戦わねばならぬ理由があるから。 　理由は、つまり、俺一人の正義。 　俺一人の正義を貫いて、敵を悪と決め付けて、殺す。 　何処かで誰かが俺を憎む。 　その誰かにとって、俺が殺した敵は正義だった―― だから俺は悪なのだ。 　正義を為して悪と成る。 　殺すものは悪であり正義であるから。 　 　　　　　　　　　　　善◆悪◆ 　　　　　　　　　　　相◆殺 　…………そう。 　それが、人を殺すという行為こと。 　その真理を心の中心へ据え置いて、 　正面から見つめて、 　俺は、一個の人間を殺す。
ja.text:
奥歯を噛む。
　強く。強く。強く。

　いま人命を奪おうとする両腕を、決して止めずに。

　何故なら。
　――それでも戦わねばならぬ理由があるから。

　理由は、つまり、俺一人の正義。
　俺一人の正義を貫いて、敵を悪と決め付けて、殺す。

　何処かで誰かが俺を憎む。
　その誰かにとって、俺が殺した敵は正義だった――
だから俺は悪なのだ。

　正義を為して悪と成る。
　殺すものは悪であり正義であるから。

　
　　　　　　　　　　　善◆悪◆
　　　　　　　　　　　相◆殺

　…………そう。
　それが、人を殺すという行為こと。

　その真理を心の中心へ据え置いて、
　正面から見つめて、

　俺は、一個の人間を殺す。

en.html:
A girl clung to the body, screaming.

Ah. His daughter.

Her name also refused to come. But this I knew: she had loved her father.

She turned her eyes toward me, swollen from crying. Fresh hatred lived there.

Why did you kill him, she asked.

I gave the reason.

That still doesn't—she cried.

Yes. It would not, would it? That reason convinced one person only. Me. My own justice.

She told me what the dead man had been to her. What a good person. How much he had loved her.

His justice, which I had never known. The justice I had just cut down, life and all.

It was indeed a justice.

Against that justice, I was the evil one.

亡骸にすがって、少女が絶叫している。
　ああ――彼の娘だ。

　名はやはり、脳裏に浮かばない。
　だが知っている――彼女が父を慕っていたこと。

　泣き腫らした瞳を、少女は俺へ向けた。
　そこには新鮮な憎悪が宿っている。

　何故殺した、と少女は言った。
　俺は理由を答えた。

　だからって、と少女は叫んだ。
　そうだろう。それは俺一人しか納得させない理由。
俺だけの正義だ。

　少女は語った。
　死んだ男が、彼女にとってどういう人間であったか。
どれほど善い人間であったか。どれほど自分を愛して
くれたか。

　俺の知らなかった、男の正義を語った。
　俺が今、命もろとも叩き斬った正義を。

　それは確かに一つの正義だった。
　その正義に対して、俺こそは邪悪だった。

en.html:
A warrior came down from the sky's highest point, abusing me.

A useless fellow who killed while not wanting to kill. Neither hero nor demon, a half-finished article.

A hero kills with his chest out. A demon kills laughing. Kageaki Minato could do neither. He could have stayed an ordinary man. Should have stayed one. That was the accusation.

—No. Wrong.

Happy about it, sad about it, what difference? Kill a person for your own sake, and you are a demon.

Hans ke maaro ya ro ke maaro. Laugh and kill, cry and kill. The person under the blade does not receive a different death because the face above it has chosen a more respectable expression. Such great concern for how the killing looks on the killer. The killed one is not looking anymore.

No.

For an ideal also, no difference. Give the slaughterer the name of hero; still a demon.

Anyone who kills a person is a demon.

That part, I understood.

Why it had taken such firm shape inside me, that I knew.

en.html:
...Even thinking it over now, that understanding remained.

Kageaki Minato killing his foster mother: wholly evil.

The will that refused to forgive that evil: wholly just.

But one mistake I had made. I had taken these for the whole of evil and justice. Nothing outside them.

Other justice, other evil—I had forgotten their possibility.

Take a prosecutor accusing a criminal. A judge sentencing him. An executioner carrying it out.

Justice is being carried out, yes. Does that mean the people doing it carry no guilt? No evil of their own?
